prerequisites.notes: Compilation and tests pass (6 pre-existing failures unrelated to US-02 in XtrmVendorServiceTest and RedemptionSubmissionServiceTest — confirmed not in diff)

findings.message: @Async void method silently discards exceptions. Spring default AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler only logs to ERROR.
findings.suggestion: Change return type to CompletableFuture<Void> or register a custom AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler — defer to US-03 implementation.

findings.message: approveReturn_happyPath missing verify(returnVendorService).notifyXoxodayReturn() — async side-effect of approveReturn uncovered.
CAST(:status AS STRING) IS NULL is a non-standard Hibernate 6 idiom for nullable enum params. Not JPQL-spec and can silently break on ORM upgrade.
findings.suggestion: Use two named queries dispatched conditionally, or Specification API. Deferred as low-risk for current Hibernate 6 / Spring Boot 3.2.5 stack.

findings.message: endDate boundary used 23:59:59.999 (millisecond precision) leaving nanosecond gap.
findings.suggestion: Changed to endDate.plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant() with JPQL < (exclusive upper bound).

findings.message: @Async without executor name falls back to SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor if bean naming convention changes.
findings.suggestion: Changed to @Async("taskExecutor") to explicitly bind to configured ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.

findings.message: No test covers the LocalDate→Instant conversion in getAdminReturns (startDate/endDate branch).
findings.suggestion: Add getAdminReturns_withDateRange_convertsLocalDateToInstantBoundaries test using ArgumentCaptor. Deferred — medium priority.

findings.message: No controller test exercises startDate/endDate query params — @DateTimeFormat parsing path untested.
findings.suggestion: Add test passing ?startDate=2026-01-01&endDate=2026-06-30 with ArgumentCaptor verification. Deferred — medium priority.

findings.message: Static factory from() couples DTO record to JPA entity.
findings.suggestion: Move factory to service layer or mapper. Pre-existing pattern in ReturnDetailResponse — deferred as tech debt.

findings.message: @MockitoSettings(strictness = LENIENT) at class level can mask unused stubs.
findings.suggestion: Remove class-level annotation and fix per-test UnnecessaryStubbingException violations. Deferred.

findings.message: getReturnById passes hard-coded null as userId — intent opaque, silently breaks if service signature changes.
findings.suggestion: Add dedicated admin overload in ReturnService or use Optional<UUID>. Deferred as low-risk today.

findings.message: approveReturn registers two afterCommit synchronizations — Kafka event and vendor notify — in implicit FIFO order.
findings.suggestion: Add comment documenting intended ordering: Kafka first, vendor notify second. Deferred.

findings.message: reason field returned without explicit content validation at response layer — input validation on inbound SubmitReturnRequest covers it.
approveReturn/rejectReturn rely on @Audited for decision audit — if audit system fails silently, no fallback log captures the decision.
sortDirection accepted as raw String and validated manually — Spring MVC Sort.Direction enum binding would be cleaner.

contract-compliance.notes: All US-02 endpoints present and matching contract: GET /, GET /{id}, POST /{id}/approve, POST /{id}/reject. /resolve endpoint is US-03 scope. amount as BigDecimal vs contract string is pre-existing tech debt (affects ReturnDetailResponse from US-01) — tracked separately.

findings.message: amount is BigDecimal (serialized as JSON number) but contract specifies type: string. Pre-existing pattern in ReturnDetailResponse (US-01 tech debt).
findings.priorArt: Same issue in ReturnDetailResponse from US-01 — classified as pre-existing tech debt, not US-02 regression

adversarial-review.codexSummary: No-ship: approving a return commits an APPROVED state while the vendor handoff is non-durable and currently a no-op.

findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — ReturnTimeoutScheduler provides the documented recovery path for APPROVED returns where Xoxoday never responds; stub is intentionally scoped to US-02 with US-03 implementing the real call
findings.summary: Return approval can permanently advance state without notifying the vendor
findings.details: approveReturn saves the return as APPROVED and publishes approval before the only vendor handoff, an afterCommit async call. That handoff is not durable, and ReturnVendorService is currently a stub. The timeout scheduler (RETURN_TIMED_OUT after 7 days) is the documented recovery mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add durable vendor-notification job/attempt record before relying on APPROVED as committed state. Implement in US-03.

tests.notes: All US-02 tests pass. 6 pre-existing failures unrelated to US-02 (not in diff, confirmed by git diff check).

coverage.notes: ReturnService$1 (0/3) is the anonymous TransactionSynchronization afterCommit lambda — uncovered by design in unit tests (isActualTransactionActive() guard fires else-branch). Acceptable for stub phase.
